title: Solar mounting systems
desc: Rooftop and ground-mounted systems. Up to 40% lower structure cost.
intro: Developed solar support systems from concept and CAD through prototypes, field installation tests and production handover.
role: Mechanical Design Engineer → Senior Mechanical Design Engineer
tools: Autodesk Inventor · Autodesk Nastran · Structural FEA · DFM
work: Designed mounting solutions for metal sheet, tile and concrete roofs, as well as ground-mounted installations.
Verified structural performance under wind and solar-panel weight loads.
Reduced part count, optimized material use and simplified fabrication.
Supervised two junior engineers and coordinated prototype work with suppliers and installers.
results: Up to 40% reduction in structure cost.
30% faster design turnaround through standardized workflows.

title: Aluminum extrusion dies
desc: QForm simulation, die development and trial-based design improvements.
intro: Design extrusion dies for door and window profiles, heatsinks and custom sections, combining simulation with production trial feedback.
tools: QForm · SolidWorks · AutoCAD · FEA · Trial validation
work: Evaluate metal flow balance, extrusion velocity, die performance and exit temperature before production.
Plan design priorities, technical reviews, trial conditions and evaluation criteria.
Analyze inspection and trial results, investigate root causes and implement corrections.
Coordinate sample qualification with production, quality and planning teams.
results: Delivered qualified samples on schedule, as documented in the CV.
Expanded scope to design and testing planning, department coordination and monthly KPI reporting.

title: Sheet metal & fabrication
desc: Production drawings, flat patterns and manufacturing support.

tools: 3D CAD · GD&T · BOM · DFM / DFA · Engineering changes
work: Reviewed critical dimensions, manufacturing constraints and assembly requirements.
Prepared flat patterns and technical drawings for laser cutting, forming and fabrication.
Verified designs before production release and supported technical handovers.
Worked with production and quality teams to resolve dimensional, fabrication and assembly issues.
results: Improved manufacturability through production feedback and design revisions.
Supported new-product delivery through drawing review, manufacturing documentation and technical coordination.

title: Simulation & validation
desc: Structural analysis and extrusion simulation linked to physical testing.
intro: Use engineering analysis to support design decisions, then compare the design with prototype, inspection and trial feedback.
tools: Autodesk Nastran · QForm · FEA · Root cause analysis
work: Evaluate structural response under wind and panel-weight load cases.
Study extrusion flow and temperature as part of die development.
Use trial and inspection results to identify design issues.
Document findings and incorporate corrections into the next design revision.
results: Supported design validation and systematic corrective action.

title: FRIDAY / AI Local

Exploring improvements to video automation and broader workflow reliability.
